# Identification of Nerves -- FIGURES
==================================================
With the NMF factors we can now call nerves and group them into invaded and non-invaded.
This code generates the figures that explain the spatial identification of the four tissue regions -- invaded nerves, non-invaded nerves, and nerve-proximal and nerve-distal tumour spots (Figure S5), together with the nerve- and tumour-signal panels of Figure 1A.

It also generates stacked barplots to depict NMF composition of invaded and non-invaded nerves, individual nerve level

It also generates a plot that depicts NMF tumor contribution in the invaded and non-invaded nerve borders Each point represents an individual spot in direct contact with a nerve, grouped by the nerve it borders (BorderID). The + symbol marks the mean tumor signal across all border spots associated with each nerve. Facets separate spots bordering invaded versus non-invaded nerves.

#===================================================================
# THIS SCRIPT ONLY GENERATES FIGURES -- it does NOT compute or modify
# NerveID/Invaded/BorderInvaded/NerveProximal. It loads nerveID.csv,
# produced once by nerve_identification_COMPUTE_historical.Rmd, and
# treats those assignments as fixed. Run this script as often as you
# like to check or regenerate any figure -- it can never renumber
# nerves or desync from a completed pathologist review, because it
# never re-runs the clustering/thresholding step.
#
# If nerveID.csv doesn't exist yet, run
# nerve_identification_COMPUTE_historical.Rmd first (once).
#
# WHAT THIS SCRIPT PRODUCES
# --------------------------
# Figures (output/03_nerve_identification/figures/):
#   - Figure1A_panel_nerve_signal.pdf
#       Figure 1A panel. Spatial map of the nerve NMF signal.
#   - Figure1A_panelb_tumor_signal.pdf
#       Figure 1A panel b. Spatial map of the tumour NMF signal.
#   - FigureS5A.pdf
#       Figure S5A. 4-panel figure (nerve signal / thresholded /
#       NerveID / invaded vs tumour background), patient 54703.
#   - FigureS5B_mean_tumor_contribution.pdf
#       Figure S5B. Histogram supporting the 1% invasion threshold.
#   - FigureS5C.pdf
#       Figure S5C. 2-panel figure (NerveID + border spots /
#       nerve-proximal zone), patient 54703.
#   - exploratory_C1q_macrophages_spatial.pdf
#       Spatial map of the C1q macrophage NMF signal. NOT in the
#       manuscript.
#   - exploratory_Invaded_nerves_NMF_composition.pdf /
#     exploratory_Noninvaded_nerves_NMF_composition.pdf
#       Per-nerve NMF composition stacked bar charts, split by
#       invasion status. NOT in the manuscript.
#
# Several chunks print a figure without saving it (the thresholded-nerve
# map, the NerveID map, the invaded-vs-tumour overlay, the border-spot
# map, the nerve-proximal map and the border tumour-content check).
# Those are inspection views; the saved versions of the ones that are
# in the manuscript are the FigureS5* panels above.
#
# Anything named "exploratory_" is not in the manuscript.
#===================================================================

## Load libraries, helper functions, color palette, and input objects
```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(scuttle)
library(batchelor)
library(scran)
library(scater)
library(bluster)
library(ggspavis)
library(dplyr)
library(RcppML)
library(ggrepel)
library(RANN)
library(plyr)
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size=14))
library(irlba)

# ---- 0. Directory structure -------------------------------------------
# Paths are relative to the project folder (the one containing input/).
# Run from there, or from scripts/ -- this moves up one level if needed.
if (basename(getwd()) == "scripts") setwd("..")
if (!dir.exists("input"))
  stop("Run this script from the project folder (the one containing input/).")

PROJECT_DIR   <- "."
INPUT_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "input")
SCRIPTS_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "scripts")

NMF_VIZ_TABLES_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", "02_NMF_visualization", "tables")

ANALYSIS_NAME <- "03_nerve_identification"
TABLES_DIR    <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "tables")
FIGURES_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "figures")
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

source(file.path(SCRIPTS_DIR, "general_functions.R"))

minmaxscale <- function(x, ...) {
    return((x - min(x, ...)) /(max(x, ...) - min(x, ...)))
}
c25 <- c(
  "dodgerblue2", "#E31A1C", # red
"green4",
"#6A3D9A", # purple
"#FF7F00", # orange
"black", "gold1",
"skyblue2", "#FB9A99", # lt pink
"palegreen2",
"#CAB2D6", # lt purple
"#FDBF6F", # lt orange
"gray70", "khaki2",
"maroon", "orchid1", "deeppink1", "blue1", "steelblue4",
"darkturquoise", "green1", "yellow4", "yellow3",
"darkorange4", "brown"
)

# ---- Load spe + FROZEN nerve identification (never recomputed here) -----
NERVEID_PATH <- file.path(TABLES_DIR, "nerveID.csv")
if (!file.exists(NERVEID_PATH)) {
  stop("nerveID.csv not found at: ", NERVEID_PATH,
       "\nRun nerve_identification_COMPUTE_historical.Rmd once first.")
}

spe <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "Integrated_NMF.rds"))
colData(spe) <- DataFrame(read.csv(NERVEID_PATH))
colnames(spe) <- spe$barcode

compk30 <- DataFrame(read.csv(file.path(NMF_VIZ_TABLES_DIR, "NMFcomp.csv")))
names(compk30)[names(compk30) == "Myeloid.Macrophages."] <- "Myeloid(Macrophages)"
names(compk30)[names(compk30) == "Myeloid.C1q_macrophages."] <- "Myeloid(C1q_macrophages)"
rownames(compk30) <- compk30$barcode
```

**Nerve Signal**
```{r}
comp <- as.matrix(t(reducedDims(spe)[["compk30"]]))
spe$nerve <- comp['Nerve',]
spe$tumor <- comp['Ductal_malignant',]
spe$C1qM <- comp['Myeloid(C1q_macrophages)',]
nerve_sginal <- ggcells(spe, aes(x=array_col, y=-array_row, color=nerve)) +
  geom_point(size=0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~sample_id,
             labeller = as_labeller(c(
               "70865bl15_highPNI" = "Patient 3 - Diseased",
               "6249bl18_noPNIandhighPNI" = "Patient 2 - Diseased",
               "70865bl5_noPNI" = "Patient 3 - Adjacent",
               "54703bl38_noPNI" = "Patient 1 - Adjacent",
               "54703bl28_highPNI" = "Patient 1 - Diseased",
               "6249bl23_noPNI" = "Patient 2 - Adjacent"
             ))) +
  theme_void()+
  scale_color_viridis_b()

nerve_sginal
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Figure1A_panel_nerve_signal.pdf"), nerve_sginal, height= 10, width=14, dpi=600)
```

#Mean tumor contribution per nerve (justifies the 1% invasion threshold)
```{r}
pd <- data.frame(colData(spe))
pd <- pd[!is.na(pd$NerveID),]
pd <- pd[!duplicated(pd$NerveID),]

b <- ggplot(pd, aes(x = mnTumor)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30,
                 fill = "grey70",
                 color = "black",
                 linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1,
             linetype = "dashed",
             linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean Tumor Contribution per Nerve",
    y = "Number of Nerves"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

b
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS5B_mean_tumor_contribution.pdf"), b, width = 10, height = 10, dpi=300)
```

# Per nerve average composition
```{r}
nerve_ids <- DataFrame(
  barcode = spe$barcode,
  id=spe$NerveID,
  invasion = spe$Invaded,
  patient = spe$patient_id
)

Comp_nerve <- as.data.frame(compk30) 
names(Comp_nerve) <- names(compk30)
Comp_nerve$ID <- plyr::mapvalues(Comp_nerve$barcode, from = nerve_ids$barcode, to=nerve_ids$id)
Comp_nerve <- tidyr::drop_na(Comp_nerve)
rownames(Comp_nerve) <- Comp_nerve$barcode
Comp_nerve$barcode <- NULL

cell_types <- setdiff(names(Comp_nerve), "ID")
Comp_nerve <- as_tibble(Comp_nerve)

nerve_comp <- Comp_nerve %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(cell_types), ~ mean(as.numeric(.x), na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

nerve_comp <- nerve_comp %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(cell_types), names_to = "CellType", values_to = "mean_score") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ID) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = if (sum(mean_score, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) 0 else 100 * mean_score / sum(mean_score, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

nerve_comp$invasion <- plyr::mapvalues(nerve_comp$ID, from = nerve_ids$id, to=nerve_ids$invasion, warn_missing = FALSE)
nerve_comp$patient_id <- plyr::mapvalues(nerve_comp$ID, from = nerve_ids$id, to=nerve_ids$patient, warn_missing = FALSE)
```

# Per individual invaded nerve
```{r}
p5 <- ggplot(nerve_comp[nerve_comp$invasion == 'Invaded',], aes(x = ID, y = pct, fill = CellType)) +
  geom_bar(width = 0.5, stat="identity",color = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_maping) +
  ggtitle("Invaded nerves NMF composition")+
  labs(x = "Nerve ID",
       y = "Composition") +
  facet_grid(~ patient_id, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x", labeller = as_labeller(c(
               "70865" = "Patient 3",
               "6249" = "Patient 2",
               "54703" = "Patient 1"))) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "exploratory_Invaded_nerves_NMF_composition.pdf"), p5, width = 14, height = 10)
```
